title: It shouldn’t be this easy to pedal 25 mph: Specialized’s Turbo Vado 3 Evo
gist: Review of Specialized's Turbo Vado 3 Evo e-bike: an 840Wh battery and 810W-peak 3.1 motor make 20-25+ mph commuting easy without range anxiety (24-mile round trip used 56% of the battery), with plush suspension, but it weighs about 70 lbs and costs $4,500-$7,000.

insights.so_what: Spec escalation in premium commuter e-bikes.

insights.claim: A 24-mile round trip on the Turbo Vado 3 Evo took 83 minutes and used just 56 percent of the battery, averaging 17 mph with a top speed of 27.3 mph.
